theorems.name: Submission.stable_second_variation_integrand_integrableOn
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (M K : Set (Rn N)) (φ : ℝ → Rn N → Rn N), MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn (tangentProjection M) M → ContDiff ℝ 1 (initialVelocity φ) → IsClosed K → (∀ x ∉ K, initialVelocity φ x = 0) → IsCompact (M ∩ K) → μHE[n] (M ∩ K) < ⊤ → (∀ y ∈ M, ∀ τ ∈ tangentSpace M y, ∀ η ∈ tangentSpace M y, inner ℝ η (fderiv ℝ (initialVelocity φ) y τ) = -inner ℝ (initialVelocity φ y) (secondFundamentalForm M y τ η)) → (∀ y ∈ M, y ∉ K → stableSecondVariationIntegrand M φ y = 0) ∧ IntegrableOn (stableSecondVariationIntegrand M φ) M μHE[n]
